verdict.rationale: The story asks for a downloadable machine-readable spec of Insomnia's own API. The probe found no OpenAPI file at any candidate path (insomnia-probe-3), and no evidence documents a published spec for Insomnia's platform API. The import/export and spec-design features (insomnia-docs-5, insomnia-docs-19) apply to users' own APIs. That is an adjacent capability, not this one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
